correctness.rationale: An exhaustive reconstruction tests all 65,536 vertex masks by two independent connected-subgraph predicates (and a third local check for the smaller stage), and independently replays each of 4,192 elementary collapse pairs against the whole remaining complex. value.rationale: A natural highly symmetric cubic graph exhibits a non-obvious filtration plateau in simple-homotopy type: an increase of 8,384 simplicial faces and two in maximal dimension is erased by actual elementary collapses fixing the earlier complex. The result determines the inclusion itself rather than an isolated invariant and gives a meaningful complete finite structural classification.
